- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1619-1642 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The WARNING that reports "the refused answer was not recorded" is gated on `invalid_park != true` (line 1625). When `invalid_park` is true, the code assumes the park itself will alert, and the two park-abandon paths (1630-1634, 1638-1642) return 0 with no alert of any kind.
  WHY: Run 2 computes `invalid_park=true`, the marker POST at line 1620 fails, and line 1625 suppresses the only WARNING. If `decide --pending-invalid-verdicts 1` then fails or returns a non-`invalid_verdicts` decision, nothing is written to the issue and nothing is paged. The item is silently retried every `--marker-hours`.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 1625 (WARNING gate) and lines 1632 / 1640 (park-abandon returns): on a park run the record-failure WARNING is suppressed, so if the park is abandoned nothing reaches a person. Suggested fix: drop `invalid_park != true` from the gate at line 1625 so a failed record write always pages once (about 1 line).
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 1630 (`--pending-invalid-verdicts 1`): the pending refusal is added even when the marker POST failed, so a single recorded refusal can reach the cap. Suggested fix: `[ "${invalid_record_rc}" -eq 0 ] && decide_pending=1` and pass `--pending-invalid-verdicts "${decide_pending:-0}"` (about 2 lines).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
